title: SpeechMetrics
description: Per-answer speech metrics returned by services/speech /analyze. Mirrored by services/speech/app/schemas.py.

language.description: Interview language chosen when the session was created (BR-26).

durationMs.description: Length of the uploaded answer audio.

speechMs.description: Time Silero VAD marked as speech.

words.description: Transcript words without vocalised fillers, each tagged with the language it was spoken in. A tag that differs from the session language marks language mixing (BR-27, BR-28).

fillers.description: Vocalised fillers (shared/labels.json fillerTokens) and lexical fillers (lexicalFillers) spoken next to a hesitation.

pauses.description: Silero VAD gaps between speech of at least shared/speech.json pauseMinMs; long is true from longPauseMs.

speakingRateWps.description: Words per second of speech, fillers excluded.

syllablesPerSecond.description: Estimated syllables per second of speech, fillers excluded.

pitchStdHz.description: Pitch variation over voiced speech frames.

volumeMeanDb.description: Mean frame level of speech in dBFS.
